items.title: We’re Hiring: Founding AI/ML Engineer at KnowYi Technologies
items.pt:
KnowYi Technologies is hiring a Founding AI/ML Engineer to help build the intelligence layer for hardware execution.

KnowYi is building the execution layer that helps hardware teams turn engineering intent into delivered industrial products.

Hardware execution rarely breaks because a team cannot find a supplier. It breaks because production intent is scattered across drawings, BOMs, CAD files, customer notes, revision history, supplier questions, inspection evidence, and delivery updates.

items.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
items.pt: Zero-shot cross-task generalization, where a policy must execute manipulation tasks never seen during training, remains a central challenge in robot learning. In large language models, a novel task can be performed simply by specifying it in the context, without any parameter update. This form of in-context learning (ICL) turns generalization into a problem of task specification. items.title: RefVideo-6M: A Reliable Reference-Based Dataset for Instructional Video Editing
items.pt: Recent advances in video editing have been largely driven by large-scale instruction-based datasets. However, existing datasets still suffer from two critical limitations. items.title: MyoMechanix: Biomechanically-Grounded Compositional Skilled Activity Understanding and Coaching
items.pt: Existing action quality assessment (AQA) datasets and methods rely primarily on visual inputs such as RGB and pose, overlooking physiological dynamics such as muscle mechanics and often modeling actions as monolithic patterns.
